title: Submissions and Service Papers
source: Defence Forces Service Writing Manual 2024 (JP-04), Chapter 5
notes: The service paper is the staff officer's principal decision-making document. Sample layouts at Annexes A-C to Chapter 5.

rules.title: Service papers must contain the mandatory headings
rules.description: INTRODUCTION, AIM, CONCLUSION and RECOMMENDATIONS are mandatory headings for all Service papers.

rules.title: The AIM follows the INTRODUCTION
rules.description: The structure runs: references, INTRODUCTION, AIM, discussion under main headings, SUMMARY if needed, CONCLUSION and RECOMMENDATIONS.

rules.title: The AIM must begin 'The aim of this service paper is to ...'
rules.description: The aim of a service paper is stated in the form 'The aim of this service paper is to ...'.

check.where: The paragraph under the AIM heading.

params.pattern: ^The aim of this (service paper|paper) is to

rules.title: Service paper subject heading is centred and bold
rules.description: The subject heading gives the main subject of the service paper, centred and bold, following the rules and conventions of service writing.

rules.title: Service papers cite references A, B, C ...
rules.description: Service papers list references at the start under the heading 'Reference:' or 'References:', lettered A, B, C in the order cited.

check.where: Start of the paper, beneath the subject heading.

rules.title: A Service paper is normally signed by the author
rules.description: A Service Paper is normally signed by the author, with the signature block showing name, rank and appointment.

check.where: Signature block at the end of the paper.

rules.title: Service papers end with a distribution list
rules.description: The distribution should be listed at the end of the paper.

rules.title: Extensive detail belongs in annexes, not the body
rules.description: To maintain the flow of argument, put extensive detail such as statistical data in annexes; only the deductions derived from the annexes need to be inserted in the body.

rules.title: JCSC write-ups requiring referencing use the APA style
rules.description: The APA style is adopted by the JCSC for all write-ups requiring referencing of cited sources.
rules.notes: Chicago footnotes are used at the JCSC for certain papers; the plugin should confirm the required style with the user.

rules.title: Annexes must be referred to in the text of the parent paper
rules.description: Annexes are referred to in the text of the parent document.
